text: Lets humans and AI agents collaborate on investigating, resolving, and acting on customer issues
quote: Pylon lets humans and agents collaborate on customer work —investigating, resolving, and acting on every signal.

text: Account Fields page can be filtered and sorted by synced fields and alphabetically
quote: You can now filter and sort the Account Fields page by synced fields and alphabetically

text: Custom object forms support per-field guidance text
quote: You can now add per-field guidance text on custom object forms

text: Provides a GET /task-statuses API endpoint to enumerate configured task statuses
quote: Added a GET /task-statuses API endpoint for enumerating configured task statuses

text: Task custom fields are visible to customers in the portal's Task Details view
quote: Task custom fields are now visible in the customer portal's Task Details view

text: Account column in Project views links directly to the account record
quote: Account column in Project views is now clickable, linking to the account record

text: Tasks can be grouped by select and multi-select fields
quote: Tasks can now be grouped by select and multi-select fields

text: Disabling a product-data sync immediately stops any run already in progress
quote: Disabling a product-data sync now stops any run already in progress

text: Web Research fields show a selected scalar value instead of raw JSON in tables
quote: Web Research fields now display the selected scalar value instead of raw JSON in tables

text: Compliance and certifications are managed via Vanta and audit partners
quote: Our compliance and certification are managed by Vanta and our incredible audit partners.

text: Templates can be reused when creating account fields from the Accounts Table column
quote: Templates are back in the create-account-field flow when adding fields from the Accounts Table column

text: Customer portal shows a consolidated issue list across all accounts a user belongs to
quote: Customer portal users can now view a consolidated issue list across all accounts they belong to

text: AI Support Agents deflect customer questions using content, gather internal context, and take action
quote: Support Agents can deflect customer questions using content, gather internal context for your team, and take action.

text: Lets teams build a swarm of multiple AI Agents to augment support staff
quote: Build your swarm of AI Agents to help augment your team.

text: Agent behavior for specific scenarios is configured via natural-language instructions
quote: Write instructions in natural language to help your AI Agent handle specific scenarios.

text: Agents can be connected to ticketing workflows via Webhooks, API, or Pylon MCP
quote: Using a combination of Webhooks, API, and/or Pylon MCP, you can connect your agent to ticketing workflows in Pylon.

text: Can simulate interactions with the AI agent to see how it handles different questions before going live
quote: Simulate an interaction with the AI and see how it handles different questions.

text: Agents can be assigned to specific issues, giving admins full control over which issues the AI touches
quote: You can assign them to issues you'd like them to take a look at. This means you have full control of which customer issues your AI agent interacts with.

text: An issue log lets admins inspect outcomes and steps taken by the AI agent on each issue
quote: The issue log allows you to inspect all the issues the AI agent is associated with and inspect the outcomes and steps taken by the AI.

text: Skills are reusable instruction sets that teach agents to handle workflows consistently
quote: Skills are reusable instructions that teach Pylon agents how to handle specific workflows consistently.

text: Admins can define Custom API tools so agents can call internal or third-party API endpoints when no MCP server exists
quote: If a system does not provide an MCP server, an administrator can define a Custom API tool that agents can use to hit internal or third party API endpoints.

text: Agents can be connected to external sources of knowledge to expand what they can answer
quote: Make them even more powerful by connecting any external sources of knowledge you have!

text: Provides a dedicated AI-supercharged knowledge hub for Q&A articles and internal runbooks
quote: A dedicated place to host your support content, including question-and-answer style articles, internal runbooks, and more -- all supercharged with AI

text: Supports customers across whichever channels they use to reach the company
quote: Pylon can support you wherever you interact with your customers.

text: Monitors connected Slack channels for customer issues and auto-bundles messages into tracked issues
quote: Pylon watches for customer issues in connected customer Slack channels and automatically bundles together relevant messages and creates tracked issues within Pylon.

text: Email addresses can be connected so support requests over email are tracked and responded to
quote: Connect your email addresses with Pylon to track and response to support requests over email.

text: Chat widgets support full custom branding, colors, and multiple separate widgets with different workflows
quote: Fully customizable colors, branding, and workflows * Multiple separate chat widgets with different branding and workflows

text: A JavaScript API lets developers build custom workflows and behavior in code
quote: JavaScript API to build workflows and customize behavior in code

text: Ships with default analytics dashboards for common support metrics, filterable by many attributes
quote: Pylon comes with a number of default analytics dashboards with common support metrics. All dashboards are filterable by a wide selection of default attributes

text: Supports building complex workflows and automations to run business processes
quote: Set up complex workflows and automations to execute your business processes

text: Public API allows programmatic access and actions on data within Pylon
quote: Pylon's API can be used to programmatically access and take action on data within Pylon.

text: Webhooks can be received for various events happening in Pylon
quote: Receive webhooks for various events happening in Pylon.

text: Daily scans customer channel conversations, uses AI to summarize them, and syncs summaries to the linked Salesforce Account
quote: Every day, Pylon scans your customer channels for conversations that were had. For every conversation, we use AI to summarize the details, and sync the summary to the relevant Account in Salesforce.

text: AI tools authenticate via OAuth with scoped access to read/update issues, accounts, and contacts
quote: AI tools authenticate with your Pylon account via OAuth and can read and update issues, accounts, and contacts within the data you can see in Pylon.
